verses.text: The angel who had been speaking with me returned and woke me, like someone being roused from sleep.
He asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a gold lampstand with a bowl on top and seven lamps on it. Each lamp has seven channels.
“There are also two olive trees beside it, one to the right of the bowl and one to the left.”
I asked the angel speaking with me, “What are these, sir?”
The angel answered, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, sir.”
He told me, “This is the LORD’s message to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might or power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.
“Who are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. He will bring out the top stone as people shout, ‘Grace, grace to it!’”
Then the LORD’s word came to me:
“Zerubbabel laid the foundation of this temple, and he will finish building it. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies sent me to you.
“Who would dare despise a day of small beginnings? These seven will rejoice when they see the plumb line in Zerubbabel’s hand. They are the LORD’s eyes, roaming throughout the earth.”
Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right and left sides of the lampstand?”
I asked him again, “What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?”
He answered, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, sir.”
He said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
